title: Flat Earth to LLA
text: Estimate geodetic latitude, longitude, and altitude from flat Earth position, 4 inputs, 2 outputs; {Units}, {Planet model}, {Flattening}, {Equatorial radius of planet} sets the radius of planet at equator, {Input reference position and orientation}, {Reference geodetic latitude and longitude (deg)} sets the initial geodetic latitude and longitude and {Direction of local tangent plane x-axis (degrees clockwise from north)} sets the angle. Values come from the instance.
